trickyParts: The control arm is the branch's merge base with main (151d2d799), not origin/main's tip. main moved under this branch in merge-gate.md, decomposition.md, design-gate.md and roles_test.go while the work ran, and an arm carrying that drift would differ from the change arm by this change plus other people's work, which is no control. arms.sh says so at the line that resolves it.

Each arm extracts four parts from its own commit and stages its own skills with its own scripts/pi-plugin-prepack.sh, as the plan's D7 says, plus packages/envoy, which the daemon module's go.mod replace needs to compile at all. The change arm is copied from the live working tree rather than a commit, so an uncommitted edit is never silently compared against itself.

Every replay session logged `Failed to load extension … Cannot find package '@legion/envoy-client'`: the arm has no node_modules, so the plugin's JS entry did not load. The skills and the agents directory still reached the session — a transcript holds skill://legion-worker's text in a tool result, and goal-red-team resolved and was dispatched — so what this change touches was under test, but no session had the legion tool, which is right for a replay with LEGION_ROLE unset.

Oh My Pi's --max-time does not interrupt a tool call already running. The first control batch spent 45 minutes inside the thermonuclear pair's go test and produced nothing. run.ts now kills the process group at the limit plus two minutes, and the reviewer task text says in both arms that the pair for this head has already run and is not the session's to run again.

discoveredComplexity: The scorer's phrase match is the measurement's weakest part. A phrase is matched on prose only (backticked spans and path:line tokens are stripped), after a run was counted on the word 'card' inside a file name; and the three counts are printed separately (adverse verdict, phrase, both) with the matched line quoted under each table, so a reader of the pull request can judge every counted row.

The gh stand-in's GraphQL route answers one fixed document whatever the query asked, because a query the call keeps in a shell variable cannot be read.
